title: Does anyone else’s mall world lead to a luxury apartment?
content: I can’t believe I found a group like this. I’ve often mentioned to my closest friends how I have 10-15 places in my dreams I constantly visit and it feels like home or places I’ve lived before. One is a mall, and another is a run-down bathroom. I’ve seen so many similar posts on here about these exact places and it’s honestly jarring. One of my main dreams is of a mall/airport that has a luxury apartment I stay in. Super modern but cozy with a lot of doors. Anyone else go there?
